in_sanskrit.name: Damor
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wealth and Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Damor एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Damor is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Dhanam’ which means wealth or prosperity. It is believed that the god of wealth, Lord Kubera, is often referred to as Damor. This name is said to bring blessings of wealth, prosperity, and abundance.
